§6.3 CPT Theorem For Spinors

6.3 CPT Theorem For Spinors

6.3.1 CPT Theorem

  • In order to have the entire Lorentz Group, we must define the following discrete transforms for spinors.

  • Time reversal 𝑇 which maps

    𝑇:(𝑡,𝑥⃗)→(−𝑡,𝑥⃗)

  • Parity 𝑃 which maps

    𝑃:(𝑡,𝑥⃗)→(𝑡,−𝑥⃗)

  • Charge conjugation

    𝐶:𝜓→−𝑖𝛾2𝜓
    reverses charge (essentially it is particle→antiparticle)
